best: Clearly titled functional blocks with explanatory notes, and power paths (four-switch stage with sense resistors and Kelvin filters, back-to-back protection FETs, current sense) drawn as recognisable left-to-right textbook circuits.
worst: USB sheet: stacked/overlapping GND pin numbers under TPD6S300 and TPS25751, and the I2C/CHG_INT bus runs as long parallel wires across the PD block instead of short labels
Gauge and charger pins fed by long dog-leg wires (cell sense, TS lines, ICHG/ILIM resistors) that must be traced to map part to pin
Uneven page use: large empty areas (Cells bottom-middle, USB centre, 3V3 lower half) next to dense clusters
